text:
Let me put it this way: Would you rather spend 3,000 THB on one visit to Dr. Bee with the Waterlase dental system, or spend 30,000 to 60,000 THB on multiple visits elsewhere? That is not a typo. In one visit, Dr Bee and assistants repaired a deep cavity with the Waterlase system. Traditional dentistry would have required multiple visits with accompanying pain and discomfort for either a root canal and crown; or an extraction, implant and crown.

Dr. Bee is the master (or is that mistress) of the art, she is the person who instructs clinics in Thailand on how to utilize the Waterlase system. Although a relatively new dental technique in Thailand, the Waterlase system has a decades long proven track record.

Dr. Bee, staff, and assistants work well in Zen like synergy with each other, checking in for comfort and explaining each step of the process. The quality of the work is meticulous. Thanks, Dr. Bee, you are the best.
